name: volvo-c303
title: Verkstadshandbok grundfordon — Terrängbil 11 och 13 (Volvo C303/C304)
domain_context: Swedish military vehicle workshop manual (Verkstadshandbok) for the Volvo C303/C304, designated Terrängbil 11 och 13 (Tgb 11/13) by the Swedish Armed Forces. Covers base-vehicle mechanical/hydraulic/electrical service and, in this section, the RBS 56 (BILL) anti-tank missile carrier variant. Translate to precise technical automotive/military English. Keep part numbers, tool numbers, and drawing references byte-identical. Translate 'Bild N' captions to 'Fig. N'.
notes: Source: scanned 200 DPI, no text layer, A4. Left/right pages alternate header-band layout; OCR misses left-page headers and diagram leader-labels (recovered by the translate pass).
